description: Canada work permit / work visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services Honest guidance by SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: How to get Canada work permit from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Most applicants need a qualifying job offer and LMIA (unless exempt), then apply to IRCC with biometrics/medicals. SK prepares documents.

faqs.question: Is Express Entry a work permit?
faqs.answer: Express Entry is mainly permanent residence. Work permits are temporary. We explain which path fits your profile.

faqs.question: SK Canada work fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000. IRCC fees separate. No guarantees.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for work permit?
faqs.answer: Not always for the permit itself, but employers and PR pathways often need language scores.

faqs.question: Can students work in Canada?
faqs.answer: Study permits have separate work-hour rules. Do not confuse with employer-specific work permits.

faqs.question: Who decides?
faqs.answer: IRCC. SK prepares honest files only.

body:
Canada work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Canada work is opportunity-rich but document-heavy: biometrics, medicals, police certificates and employer compliance.

Requirements

  • Job offer and LMIA or LMIA-exempt pathway
  • Passport, photos, IMM forms
  • Proof you will leave if required by temporary status rules
  • Medical exam and police certificates when requested
  • Biometrics for Pakistan applicants

Process

  1. Pathway assessment (employer-specific vs open where eligible)
  2. Document checklist
  3. Online application packaging
  4. Biometrics / medical scheduling support
  5. Decision follow-up

Documents

  • Passport and photos
  • Offer letter / LMIA docs
  • CV, degrees, experience letters
  • Police certificates
  • Medical eMedical report when required

Related checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. IRCC fees and medicals separate.

Timeline

Often several months; medicals and biometrics add time.

Common mistakes

  • Fake Canadian job offers
  • Missing police certificates from all countries of residence
  • Inconsistent employment dates
  • Ignoring Provincial nominee vs work-permit differences

Related links

Canada study · Canada appointment · Jobs

Also see: Visit Visa hub · Study Visa hub · Answers

Work route reality check for Canada

LMIA/employer pathways vary; study-to-work is a different track from a fresh work file.

SK Immigration helps with CV packaging, document checklists and appointment prep. We do not sell fake job guarantees. Employers and missions decide.

Before you pay anyone

  • Confirm the job/contract type matches the visa subclass
  • Language level matches employer expectations
  • Educational documents follow the correct attestation chain
  • You understand SK fees vs medical/government fees
